finding: Dedicated lead workspace exists with server-backed search/filtering, saved views and lifecycle actions; code is evidence, not certification.
Dedicated account workspace, hierarchy/merge APIs and customer-360 surfaces exist; shared party ownership still requires explicit governance.
Dedicated contact list/detail/create-edit workflows and duplicate/merge APIs exist; privacy and content-level visibility remain specification controls.
Dedicated lead-source administration workspace and API validation exist; source provenance must be governed across conversion/reporting.
Assignment policy/workspace and governed lead assignment APIs exist, including rule and round-robin foundations.
Lead qualification card, API and domain service exist; specification separates qualification authority from scoring.
Lead lifecycle workspace and stage transition APIs exist with history/governance foundations.
Lead/account/contact duplicate endpoints and merge services exist; survivorship and precision remain explicit specification requirements.
Opportunity detail workspace, stage/probability commands and supporting domain services exist; downstream quotation remains Sales-owned.
Responsive pipeline board and governed stage movement exist, including keyboard/native alternatives and optimistic concurrency patterns.
Probability action and revenue-intelligence services exist with history and calculation foundations.
Dedicated stage configuration workspace and stage APIs exist; live-pipeline change semantics need formal governance.
Dedicated calls workspace and start/complete/cancel API lifecycle exist.
Meeting workspace, lifecycle APIs and public meeting booking endpoints exist.
Task domain operations and start/cancel/history endpoints exist; explicit F015 certification was weaker than earlier F-IDs in prior targeted naming.
Lead follow-up API exists and activity infrastructure can support generalized reminders; channel semantics need explicit specification.
Lead notes and attachment routes exist; security scanning, privacy classes and shared attachment service behavior remain explicit design requirements.
CRM communications service includes send/sync/inbox/webhook/timeline capabilities; sensitive email content needs finer authorization than record visibility alone.
Timeline endpoint and detail-data aggregation exist; unified ordering and per-item visibility must be certified.
Enterprise CRM migration defines sales teams and territories; operator-facing governance and hierarchy semantics need formal specification.
Generic CRM import/export routes and acquisition import infrastructure exist; pass must define safe mapping, async jobs and row-level results.
Lead conversion endpoint and conversion records exist; field mapping, existing/new resolution and retry idempotency must be explicit.
Opportunity detail already exposes a permission-guarded Sales quotation handoff, matching the intended module boundary.
CRM dashboard API and page infrastructure exist; KPI formulas and authorization-safe aggregation need formal contracts.
Forecast page and enterprise forecast tables exist; reproducible snapshots, hierarchy and adjustment semantics require certification.
Dedicated outcome-reason migration and pipeline close support exist; catalogue version/history semantics need specification.
Lead score endpoints and intelligence services exist with scoring tables; deterministic model governance and ML separation remain requirements.
Custom-field and tag APIs/tables exist; typed lifecycle, indexing and field-level access need formal contracts.
Lead and opportunity operations endpoints exist; standard async job semantics and dangerous-action controls need specification.
Reports page, report API and report-definition tables exist; semantic metric governance and security reconciliation need specification.
